user.title: Android Management API
user.description: Enter your enterprise name and choose how to provide service account credentials.

data_description.enterprise_name: The full enterprise resource name, e.g. enterprises/LC00t1kz5a

credentials_json.title: Service Account JSON
credentials_json.description: Paste the full contents of your Google service account JSON key file.

credentials_file.title: Service Account File
credentials_file.description: Provide the absolute path to the service account JSON key file on disk.

error.invalid_json: Invalid JSON. Please paste valid service account key contents.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Android Management API. Check your credentials and enterprise name.
error.file_not_found: The specified file was not found.

init.title: Android Management Policy Settings
init.description: Choose a category to configure, then select Apply Policy to push your settings to the enterprise.

kiosk_app.title: Kiosk App Settings
kiosk_app.description: Configure the primary kiosk app and any additional apps to install.

data_description.package_name: Android package name of the primary kiosk app (e.g. com.example.app)
data_description.additional_packages: One package name per line. These apps are force-installed alongside the primary kiosk app.

kiosk_ui.title: Kiosk UI Customization
kiosk_ui.description: Control which UI elements are available in kiosk mode.

display.title: Display Settings
display.description: Configure screen brightness and timeout behavior.

security.title: Security & Privacy
security.description: Configure security overrides, location, and app verification settings.

network.title: Network & Connectivity
network.description: Enable or disable network-related configuration options.

restrictions.title: Device Restrictions
restrictions.description: Control which device features and actions are allowed.

system.title: System Settings
system.description: Configure global system behavior, updates, and support messages.

data_description.maximum_time_to_lock: Maximum time in milliseconds before the screen locks. 0 = no restriction.
data_description.long_support_message: Shown on the device admin settings screen.

device_reporting.title: Device Reporting
device_reporting.description: Control which diagnostic data the device reports. Enable these to populate Android Version, Build Number, IMEI, WiFi MAC, and other sensors that may show Unknown when disabled.

data.software_info_enabled: Report software info (Android version, build, kernel, etc.)
data.network_info_enabled: Report network info (IMEI, WiFi MAC, operator)

data_description.software_info_enabled: Enables Android Version, Build Number, Kernel Version, Security Patch Level, Device Policy Version, Primary Language, System Update Status
data_description.network_info_enabled: Enables IMEI, WiFi MAC Address, Network Operator
data_description.memory_info_enabled: Enables Total RAM and storage sensors

apply_policy.title: Apply Policy
apply_policy.description: Push the configured settings to the enterprise as a policy. This will overwrite the existing policy with the given ID.

error.apply_failed: Failed to apply the policy. Check logs for details.
